u0: Initial state: the blocking ball is still in front of the door (or the agent is not yet carrying a matching key) and the agent does not hold the door key. Next objective: either pick up the ball to clear the door cell (blocker_moved without the key, advancing to u1) or pick up the matching key (advancing to u2). Do not drop a matching key while the door is closed, which would fire key_lost and return here.
u1: Progress state: the blocker has been moved off the door cell and the agent does not hold the door key. Next objective: acquire the matching key from the start room to advance to u2; the ball may be carried or dropped away from the door, but dropping it back in front of the door reverts blocker_moved and returns to u0.
u2: Progress state: the agent holds the matching key and the door is not yet open. Next objective: move to the reachable toggle position in front of the door (blocker no longer there) and toggle it open to advance to u3. Danger: dropping the key now, while the door is closed, fires key_lost and returns to u0; keep the key until the door is open.
u3: Progress state: the door is open, granting access to the box room. Next objective: enter the other room, identify the mission-designated box, and pick it up to complete the episode at uF. The key may be dropped now without triggering key_lost.
u4: Intermediate absorbing state with no incoming transitions in this reward machine: the agent can only remain here or transition on target_picked_up to uF. If encountered, the objective is to pick up the mission's designated box to finish.
uF: Terminal success state: the mission's designated target box has been picked up and the episode ends. The constraint against losing the key while the door was closed was respected along the path.
